description: We are a dynamic and highly motivated tech team passionate about building visually striking and functionally robust applications. Led by Eyad Ramy, who specializes in web development and creative 2D design, our core philosophy is bridging the gap between beautiful aesthetics and solid code to create engaging user experiences. We are joined by a talented roster of developers and problem-solvers: Omar Ahmed, Omar Ehab, Adham Ashraf, and Elhussein Mostafa.
